crossRefs.note: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on…
He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

translations.web: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
translations.bsb: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
translations.asv: And it came to pass at even, that the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the camp.
